threads.title: Ukraine war talks and Patriot shortage
threads.summary: Peace efforts stalled after the 19 November Shenzhen summit and Russia's 20 November strikes on Kyiv. On 21 November drones hit the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland. Finland's military said Ukraine was likely responsible, and Finland reimposed restrictions. On 22 November the corvette Merkury was struck at Benghazi in a suspected Ukrainian sea-drone attack and reportedly sank. No one has claimed the Benghazi attack. No talks date is set.

Day one ended after nearly four hours. Zelensky called it constructive, and a 1,000-for-1,000 or 1,500-for-1,500 prisoner swap was discussed. Russia raised territory. Rubio and Merz played down hopes of a quick deal.

The round ended on 11 November with no breakthrough but a large prisoner exchange agreed, with no number or date. The BBC says talks centred on Europe's post-war security; US envoys now head to Moscow.

The envoys met Putin in Moscow and Zelensky near Dublin on 12 November. Kushner says the biggest prisoner swap of the war is finalised. Europe named a five-country team; Moscow has not agreed to include it.
New: Zelensky says US negotiators asked, for the first time, whether Ukraine would leave Donbas if it joined NATO. Estonia will close its Russian border from 1 December after a GRU-linked arson plot.

China's Foreign Ministry confirmed the summit on 16 November. Peskov says Shenzhen agreements cannot be imposed on others. Zelensky says Starshield speed limits stop interceptor drones catching Shahed drones.

The war moved to distant seas. On 21 November drones hit the Russian cargo ship Sparta II off Finland. On 22 November the Russian corvette Merkury was struck at Benghazi, Libya, and reportedly sank.
